attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The entry names all six of its members and gives each his own couplet and his own paragraph, so it is one folder per named member and each relates the others. The page quotes Chrysostom as reckoning this Sosthenes and Crispus, whom it refers to 4 December, to be one person — «Oίμαι δε τούτον και Σωσθένη λέγεσθαι» — which is an identity claim quoted by the page and not made by it, so no `related` row and no merge is drafted from it; it is recorded here for the author. The corpus keeps a `sosthenes-of-chalcedon`, a soldier martyr of the Russian 16 September, who is another entry and another man. The page prints one hymn, an apolytikion that names Tychicus, so it is his and not this man's. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
